description: First golden fixture: the FSANZ guidance example (12 servings, 60 mL serving, 1 standard drink, 355 kJ per serving, 592 kJ per 100 mL), as quoted in Build Brief 01 section 9. The brief does not state the example's ABV: 21.1% is used because it gives 1.0 standard drink per 60 mL serving. Package volume is 12 x 60 mL = 720 mL. Replace the ABV if the FSANZ example states one.
